title: Orphanage or mental asylum?
content: So I wanna start out by saying that I just recently found this community and was reading through a few posts and although I didn't recognize this mall place you guys are talking about, I did come by something that sounded similar to a dream I've had before. Also I tried to write down every detail I could remember so I'm sorry in advance if it's pretty long. So I don't remember how long I had been dreaming but I suddenly became conscious at one point, I think it was right after climbing through a window into some strange-looking building with some girl behind me that I seemed to be familiar with in the dream? And as soon as I became conscious, she wasn't there anymore --- I think she had just led me into that building and then disappeared. I remember that it was a somewhat small room with wooden floorboards and that it looked so dirty that it barely seemed like somewhere you could live. It was nighttime and there was no light source in the room --- only from a hallway I could see through an open door. In the hallway, there was a bunch of people dressed in white --- patients I think, stumbling around like they were half asleep or brain dead. It was kinda hard to see any other details of the room but I remember a bunch of children-size, white beds lined up and crammed inside the room, and some grown adult tightly strapped down to one of them. That's when I looked behind me for the girl I came in with and realized she was gone. When I turned back around there was suddenly some lady standing in front of me. She had black hair and was tall, slim, and so skinny that her eyes looked like they were bulging out a little. I don't think this was the first thing she said, but next thing I remember, she's trying to get me to jump out the window I came in through, saying that we'll escape together. I don't know how I knew, but I remember thinking it was obvious that she was trying to trick me, so I politely told her that I didn't think we were supposed to leave and that she could go if she wanted to, but that I wasn't going with her. She seemed pleased I think, and as she walked out of the room, I remember assuming that she was leaving to report back to somebody and that it was my chance to escape. She left the window open and I climbed out and just started running through the streets. I ran around a corner and began going up a hill, but then decided that she could catch me easily if she was in a car. I was in a neighborhood so I ran to my left, behind the bushes in front of a random house. I watched the road from there and in like a second, I saw that same lady running up the hill so fast that it didn't seem human --- like in a way that no human could move their body. After seeing that, I felt that something was seriously wrong. I started pounding on the door of the house I was at and some young couple answered. I forced myself inside and started telling them everything that happened, begging them to call the police. The man looked at me with some expression that made me realize he already knew about what I was telling him, and that it was probably something I shouldn't know. I started trying to play it off, saying that I would just leave quietly and he could pretend that I didn't even go there and that if he called the lady here then I would tell his wife about the place he worked at. He kept staring at me in the same way and I realized that the lady already knew. The doorbell rang and of course, when he answered it, the lady was there. I don't know what the f-ck I was thinking but I suddenly jumped at her and started clawing at her face and hair, trying to kill her I think? I stopped as some black limo pulled up in front of the house and a guy with brown hair and a black suit stepped out of the car. He was staring at me like he was waiting for me to get inside. After like a moment of us staring at each other, I woke up. I'm sorry this was so long and that I kinda got side-tracked, but the evil hospital place some of you guys described (or a slaughterhouse?) really reminded me of this place. Please tell me if you know anything and thanks for reading :)
